name: Kineticist Elements – Legendary Games — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Kineticist Elements – Paizo, Inc." but are not part of the Kineticist Elements – Legendary Games entry, which is unchanged.
